options.label: Zombie Count
options.tooltip: Changing this also sets the "Population Multiplier" in Advanced Zombie Options.

options.label: Zombie Distribution
options.tooltip: How zombies are distributed across the map.

options.label: Voronoi Noise
options.tooltip: Controls whether some randomization is applied to zombie distribution.

options.label: Zombie Respawn
options.tooltip: How frequently new zombies are added to the world.

options.label: Zombie Migration
options.tooltip: Zombie allowed to migrate to empty cells.

options.label: Zombie Attraction Multiplier
options.tooltip: General engine loudness to zombies.

options.label: Zombie count before deletion
options.tooltip: How many zombies can occupy a certain area.

options.label: Speed
options.tooltip: How fast zombies move.

options.label: Random Sprinter Amount
options.tooltip: If Random Speed is enabled, this controls what percentage of zombies are Sprinters. Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom percentage.

options.label: Strength
options.tooltip: The damage zombies inflict per attack.

options.label: Toughness
options.tooltip: The difficulty of killing a zombie.

options.label: Transmission
options.tooltip: How the Knox Virus spreads.

options.label: Infection Mortality
options.tooltip: How quickly the infection takes effect.

options.label: Reanimate Time
options.tooltip: How quickly infected corpses rise as zombies.

options.label: Cognition
options.tooltip: Zombie intelligence.

options.label: Crawl Under Vehicle
options.tooltip: How often zombies can crawl under parked vehicles.

options.label: Memory
options.tooltip: How long zombies remember a player after seeing or hearing them.

options.label: Sight
options.tooltip: Zombie vision radius.

options.label: Hearing
options.tooltip: Zombie hearing radius.

options.label: New Stealth System
options.tooltip: Activates the new advanced stealth mechanics, which allows you to hide from zombies behind cars, takes traits and weather into account, and much more.

options.label: Environmental Attacks
options.tooltip: If zombies that have not seen/heard player can attack doors and constructions while roaming.

options.label: Damage Construction
options.tooltip: If zombies can destroy player constructions and defenses.

options.label: Day/Night Zombie Speed Effect
options.tooltip: Whether zombies are more "active" during the day or night. "Active" zombies will use the speed set in the "Speed" setting. "Inactive" zombies will be slower, and tend not to give chase.

options.label: Zombie House Alarm Triggering
options.tooltip: If zombies trigger house alarms when breaking through windows or doors.

options.label: Drag Down
options.tooltip: If multiple attacking zombies can drag you down and kill you. Dependent on zombie strength.

options.label: Crawlers Drag Down
options.tooltip: If crawler zombies beside a player contribute to the chance of being dragged down and killed by a group of zombies.

options.label: Zombie Lunge
options.tooltip: If zombies have a chance to lunge at you after climbing over a fence or through a window if you're too close.

options.label: Zombie Armor Factor
options.tooltip: Serves as a multiplier when determining the effectiveness of armor worn by zombies.

options.label: Maximum Zombie Armor Defense
options.tooltip: The maximum defense percentage that any worn protective garments can provide to a zombie.

options.label: Chance Of Attached Weapon
options.tooltip: Percentage chance of having a random attached weapon.

options.label: Zombie Fall Damage Multiplier
options.tooltip: How much damage zombies take when falling from height.

options.label: Fake Dead Zombie Reanimation
options.tooltip: Whether some dead-looking zombies will reanimate and attack the player.

options.label: Player Spawn Area
options.tooltip: Zombies will not spawn where players spawn.

options.label: Zombies To Damage Fences
options.tooltip: How many zombies it takes to damage a tall fence.

options.label: Fence Damage Multiplier
options.tooltip: How quickly zombies damage tall fences.

options.label: Start Month
options.tooltip: Month in which the game starts.

options.label: Start Day
options.tooltip: Day of the month in which the games starts.

options.label: Start Hour
options.tooltip: Hour of the day in which the game starts.

options.label: Day / Night Cycle
options.tooltip: Whether the time of day changes naturally, or it's always day/night.

options.label: Months since the Apocalypse
options.tooltip: How long after the end of the world to begin. This will affect starting world erosion and food spoilage. Does not affect the starting date.

options.label: Darkness during night
options.tooltip: The level of ambient lighting at night.

options.label: Length of nights
options.tooltip: The time from dusk to dawn.

options.label: Water Shutoff
options.tooltip: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that plumbing fixtures (eg. sinks) stop being infinite sources of water.

options.label: Electricity Shutoff
options.tooltip: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that the world's electricity turns off for good.

options.label: Alarm Battery Decay
options.tooltip: How long alarm batteries can last for after the power shuts off.

options.label: Water Shutoff (WaterShutModifier)
options.tooltip: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that plumbing fixtures (eg. sinks) stop being infinite sources of water.

options.label: Electricity Shutoff (ElecShutModifier)
options.tooltip: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that the world's electricity turns off for good.

options.label: Alarm Battery Decay (AlarmDecayModifier)
options.tooltip: How long alarm batteries can last for after the power shuts off.

options.label: House Alarms Frequency
options.tooltip: How likely the player is to activate a house alarm when breaking into a new house.

options.label: Locked Houses Frequency
options.tooltip: How frequently the doors of homes and buildings will be locked when discovered.

options.label: Helicopter
options.tooltip: How regularly a helicopter passes over the Event Zone.

options.label: Meta Event
options.tooltip: How often zombie-attracting metagame events like distant gunshots will occur.

options.label: Sleeping Event
options.tooltip: How often events during the player's sleep, like nightmares, occur.

options.label: Generator Fuel Consumption
options.tooltip: How much fuel is consumed by generators per in-game hour.

options.label: Generators
options.tooltip: The chance of electrical generators spawning on the map.

options.label: Fire Spread
options.tooltip: If fires spread when started.

options.label: Generator Working in Exterior
options.tooltip: If enabled, generators will work on exterior tiles. This will allow, for example, the powering of gas pumps.

options.label: Siren Shutoff Hours
options.tooltip: How many in-game hours before a wailing siren shuts off.

options.label: Generator vertical range
options.tooltip: How many levels both above and below a generator it can provide with electricity.

options.label: Perishable Food
options.tooltip: Any food that can rot or spoil.

options.label: Other Literature
options.tooltip: All other items that can be read, including books, fliers, and newspapers.

options.label: Skill Books
options.tooltip: Books that provide skill XP multipliers.

options.label: Recipe Resources
options.tooltip: Items that teach recipes.

options.label: Medical
options.tooltip: Medicine, bandages and first aid tools.

options.label: Survival Essentials
options.tooltip: Fishing Rods, Tents, camping gear etc.

options.label: Non-Perishable Food
options.tooltip: Canned and dried food, beverages.

options.label: Melee Weapons
options.tooltip: Weapons that are not tools in other categories.

options.label: Ranged Weapons
options.tooltip: Also includes weapon attachments.

options.label: Ammo
options.tooltip: Loose ammo, boxes and magazines.

options.label: Mechanics
options.tooltip: Vehicle parts and the tools needed to install them.

options.label: Other
options.tooltip: Everything else. Also affects foraging for all items in Town/Road zones.

options.label: Clothing
options.tooltip: All wearable items that are not containers.

options.label: Bags
options.tooltip: Backpacks and other wearable/equippable containers, eg. cases.

options.label: Keys
options.tooltip: Keys for buildings/cars, key rings, and locks.

options.label: Media
options.tooltip: VHS tapes and CDs.

options.label: Mementos
options.tooltip: Spiffo items, plushies, and other collectible keepsake items eg. Photos.

options.label: Cooking
options.tooltip: Items that are used in cooking, including those (eg. knives) which can be weapons. Does not include food. Includes both usable and unusable items.

options.label: Material
options.tooltip: Items and weapons that are used as ingredients for crafting or building. This is a general category that does not include items belonging to other categories such as Cookware or Medical. Does not include Tools.

options.label: Farming
options.tooltip: Items and weapons which are used in both animal and plant agriculture, such as Seeds, Trowels, or Shovels.

options.label: Tools
options.tooltip: Items and weapons which are Tools but don't fit in other categories such as Mechanics or Farming.

options.label: Rolls Multiplier [!]
options.tooltip: <BHC> [!] It is recommended that you DO NOT change this. [!] <RGB:1,1,1> Can be used to adjust the number of rolls made on loot tables when spawning loot. Will not reduce the number of rolls below 1. Can negatively affect performance if set to high values. It is highly recommended that this not be changed.

options.label: Loot Item Removal List
options.tooltip: A comma-separated list of item types that won't spawn as ordinary loot.

options.label: Remove Unwanted Story Loot
options.tooltip: If enabled, items on the Loot Item Removal List, or that have their rarity set to 'None', will not spawn in randomised world stories.

options.label: Remove Unwanted Zombie Loot
options.tooltip: If enabled, items on the Loot Item Removal List, or that have their rarity set to 'None', will not spawn worn by, or attached to, zombies.

options.label: Zombie Population Loot Effect
options.tooltip: If greater than 0, the spawn of loot is increased relative to the number of nearby zombies, with the effect multiplied by this number.

options.label: Starter Kit
options.tooltip: Spawn with Chips, a Water Bottle, a Small Backpack, a Baseball Bat, and a Hammer.

options.label: Loot Seen Prevent Hours
options.tooltip: When greater than 0, loot will not respawn in zones that have been visited within this number of in-game hours.

options.label: Hours for Loot Respawn
options.tooltip: When greater than 0, after X hours, all containers in towns and trailer parks in the world will respawn loot. To spawn loot a container must have been looted at least once. Loot respawn is not impacted by visibility or subsequent looting.

options.label: Max Items For Loot Respawn
options.tooltip: Containers with a number of items greater, or equal to, this setting will not respawn.

options.label: Construction Prevents Loot Respawn
options.tooltip: Items will not respawn in buildings that players have barricaded or built in.

options.label: Annotated Map Chance
options.tooltip: How often a looted map will have notes on it, written by a deceased survivor.

options.label: Randomized Building Chance
options.tooltip: The chance of finding randomized buildings on the map (eg. burnt out houses, ones containing loot stashes or dead bodies).

options.label: Randomized Road Stories Chance
options.tooltip: The chance of road stories (eg. police roadblocks) spawning.

options.label: Randomized Zone Stories Chance
options.tooltip: The chance of stories specific to map zones (eg. a campsite in a forest) spawning.

options.label: Maximum Looted Building Rooms
options.tooltip: If a building has more than this amount of rooms it will not be looted.

options.label: Maximum Looted Building Chance
options.tooltip: The chance that any building will already be looted when found. Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom number.

options.label: Days Until Max Looted Building Chance
options.tooltip: How long it takes for Maximum Looted Building Chance to be reached.

options.label: Rural Building Looted Chance Multiplier
options.tooltip: The chance that any rural building will already be looted when found. Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom number.

options.label: Maximum Diminished Loot Percentage
options.tooltip: The maximum loot that won't spawn when Days Until Maximum Diminished Loot is reached. Check the "Advanced" box below to use an exact percentage.

options.label: Days Until Maximum Diminished Loot
options.tooltip: How long it takes for Maximum Diminished Loot Percentage to be reached.

options.label: Climate Cycle
options.tooltip: Whether weather changes or remains at a single state.

options.label: Fog Cycle
options.tooltip: Whether fog occurs naturally, never occurs, or is always present.

options.label: Temperature
options.tooltip: The global temperature.

options.label: Rain
options.tooltip: How often it rains.

options.label: Erosion Speed
options.tooltip: Number of days until the erosion system (which adds vines, long grass, new trees etc. to the world) will reach 100%% growth.

options.label: Erosion Days
options.tooltip: For a custom Erosion Speed. Zero means use the Erosion Speed option. Maximum is 36,500 days (approximately 100 years).

options.label: Farming Speed
options.tooltip: The speed of plant growth.

options.label: Compost Time
options.tooltip: How long it takes for food to break down in a composter.

options.label: Nature's Abundance
options.tooltip: The abundance of items found in Foraging mode.

options.label: Plant Resilience
options.tooltip: How much water plants will lose per day, and their ability to avoid disease.

options.label: Farming's Abundance
options.tooltip: The yield of plants when harvested.

options.label: Maximum Fog Intensity
options.tooltip: Maximum intensity of fog.

options.label: Maximum Rain FX Intensity
options.tooltip: Maximum intensity of rain.

options.label: Snow on Ground
options.tooltip: If snow will accumulate on the ground. If disabled, snow will still show on vegetation and rooftops.

options.label: Fishing Abundance
options.tooltip: The abundance of fish in rivers and lakes.

options.label: Kill Crops Grown Inside
options.tooltip: When enabled, crops and herbs grown inside buildings will die. Does not affect houseplants.

options.label: Plant Growing Seasons
options.tooltip: When enabled, the growth of plants is affected by seasons.

options.label: Farms not on Ground Level [!]
options.tooltip: <BHC> [!] It is recommended that you DO NOT change this. Changing this can result in performance issues. [!] <RGB:1,1,1> When enabled, dirt can be placed, and farming performed on other than the ground level.

options.label: Farming Speed (FarmingSpeedNew)
options.tooltip: The speed of plant growth.

options.label: Farming Abundance
options.tooltip: The abundance of harvested crops.

options.label: Clay chance - Lake
options.tooltip: Chance to turn a dirt floor into a clay floor. Applies to lakes.

options.label: Clay chance - River
options.tooltip: Chance to turn a dirt floor into a clay floor. Applies to rivers.

options.label: Stats Decrease
options.tooltip: How fast the player's hunger, thirst, and fatigue will decrease.

options.label: Nutrition System
options.tooltip: Nutritional value of food affects the player's condition. Turning this off will stop the player gaining or losing weight.

options.label: Food Spoilage
options.tooltip: How fast that food will spoil, inside or outside of a fridge.

options.label: Refrigeration Effectiveness
options.tooltip: How effective a fridge will be at keeping food fresh for longer.

options.label: Endurance Regeneration
options.tooltip: Recovery from being tired after performing actions.

options.label: Free Trait Points
options.tooltip: Adds free points during character creation.

options.label: Player-built Construction Strength
options.tooltip: Gives player-built constructions extra hit points so they are more resistant to zombie damage.

options.label: Bone Fracture
options.tooltip: If survivors can get broken limbs from impacts, zombie damage, falls etc.

options.label: Injury Severity
options.tooltip: The impact that injuries have on your body, and their healing time.

options.label: Time Before Corpse Removal
options.tooltip: How long, in hours, before dead zombie bodies disappear from the world. If 0, maggots will not spawn on corpses.

options.label: Decaying Corpse Health Impact
options.tooltip: The impact that nearby decaying bodies has on the player's health and emotions.

options.label: Zombie Health Impact
options.tooltip: Whether nearby "living" zombies have the same impact on the player's health and emotions.

options.label: Blood Level
options.tooltip: How much blood is sprayed on floors and walls by injuries.

options.label: Clothing Degradation
options.tooltip: How quickly clothing degrades, becomes dirty, and bloodied.

options.label: Rotten Food Removal
options.tooltip: Number of in-game days before rotten food is removed from the map. -1 means rotten food is never removed.

options.label: Melee Movement Disruption
options.tooltip: If melee attacking slows you down.

options.label: All Clothing Unlocked
options.tooltip: Allows you to select from every piece of clothing in the game when customizing your character

options.label: Enable 'Tainted Water' tooltip
options.tooltip: If tainted water will show a warning marking it as such.

options.label: Weapon Multi Hit
options.tooltip: If certain melee weapons will be able to strike multiple zombies in one hit.

options.label: Rear Vulnerability
options.tooltip: Chance of being bitten when a zombie attacks from behind.

options.label: Enable Poisoning
options.tooltip: If poison can be added to food.

options.label: Corpse Maggot Spawn
options.tooltip: If/when maggots can spawn in corpses.

options.label: Negative Traits Penalty
options.tooltip: If there are diminishing returns on bonus trait points provided from selecting multiple negative traits.

options.label: Muscle Strain Factor
options.tooltip: Functions as a multiplier when applying muscle strain from swinging weapons or carrying heavy loads.

options.label: Discomfort Factor
options.tooltip: Functions as a multiplier when applying discomfort from worn items.

options.label: Wound Infection Damage Factor
options.tooltip: If greater than zero damage can be taken from serious wound infections.

options.label: No Black Clothes
options.tooltip: If true clothing with randomized tints will not be so dark to be virtually black.

options.label: Easy Climbing
options.tooltip: Disables the failure chances when climbing sheet ropes or over walls.

options.label: Media List Meta Knowledge
options.tooltip: If a piece of media hasn't been fully seen or read, this setting determines whether it's displayed fully, displayed as "???", or hidden completely.

options.label: See Not Known Recipes
options.tooltip: If true, you will be able to see any recipes that can be done with a station, even if you haven't learnt them yet.

options.label: Maximum Media XP Level
options.tooltip: When a skill is at this level or above, television/VHS/other media will not provide XP for it.

options.label: Maximum Dismantling XP Level
options.tooltip: When a skill is at this level or above, scrapping furniture does not provide XP for the relevant skill. Does not apply to Electrical.

options.label: Literature Cooldown Days
options.tooltip: Number of days before one can benefit from reading previously read literature items.

options.label: Minutes Per Skill Book Page
options.tooltip: The number of in-game minutes it takes to read one page of a skill book.

options.label: Global Multiplier
options.tooltip: The rate at which all skills level up.

options.label: Use Global Multiplier
options.tooltip: When enabled, all skills will use the Global Multiplier.

options.label: Fitness Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Fitness skill levels up.

options.label: Strength Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Strength skill levels up.

options.label: Sprinting Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Sprinting skill levels up.

options.label: Lightfooted Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Lightfooted skill levels up.

options.label: Nimble Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Nimble skill levels up.

options.label: Sneaking Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Sneaking skill levels up.

options.label: Axe Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Axe skill levels up.

options.label: Long Blunt Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Long Blunt skill levels up.

options.label: Short Blunt Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Short Blunt skill levels up.

options.label: Long Blade Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Long Blade skill levels up.

options.label: Short Blade Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Short Blade skill levels up.

options.label: Spear Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Spear skill levels up.

options.label: Maintenance Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Maintenance skill levels up.

options.label: Carpentry Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Carpentry skill levels up.

options.label: Cooking Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Cooking skill levels up.

options.label: Agriculture Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Agriculture skill levels up.

options.label: First Aid Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which First Aid skill levels up.

options.label: Electrical Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Electrical skill levels up.

options.label: Welding Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Welding skill levels up.

options.label: Mechanics Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Mechanics skill levels up.

options.label: Tailoring Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Tailoring skill levels up.

options.label: Aiming Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Aiming skill levels up.

options.label: Reloading Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Reloading skill levels up.

options.label: Fishing Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Fishing skill levels up.

options.label: Trapping Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Trapping skill levels up.

options.label: Foraging Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Foraging skill levels up.

options.label: Knapping Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Knapping skill levels up.

options.label: Masonry Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Masonry skill levels up.

options.label: Pottery Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Pottery skill levels up.

options.label: Carving Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Carving skill levels up.

options.label: Animal Care Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Animal Care skill levels up.

options.label: Tracking Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Tracking skill levels up.

options.label: Blacksmithing Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Blacksmithing skill levels up.

options.label: Butchering Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Butchering skill levels up.

options.label: Glassmaking Multiplier
options.tooltip: Rate at which Glassmaking skill levels up.

options.label: Vehicles
options.tooltip: If vehicles will spawn.

options.label: Vehicle Spawn Rate
options.tooltip: How frequently vehicles can be discovered on the map.

options.label: Easy Use
options.tooltip: Whether found vehicles are locked, need keys to start etc.

options.label: Initial Gas
options.tooltip: How full the gas tank of discovered vehicles will be.

options.label: Infinite Gas Pumps
options.tooltip: If enabled, gas pumps will never run out of fuel

options.label: Initial Minimum Gas Pump Amount
options.tooltip: The minimum amount of gasoline that can spawn in gas pumps. Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom amount.

options.label: Initial Maximum Gas Pump Amount
options.tooltip: The maximum amount of gasoline that can spawn in gas pumps. Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom amount.

options.label: Initial Gas Pump Empty Chance
options.tooltip: The chance, as a percentage, that individual gas pumps will initially have no fuel.

options.label: Locked Vehicle Frequency
options.tooltip: How likely cars will be locked

options.label: Gas Consumption
options.tooltip: How gas-hungry vehicles are.

options.label: General Condition
options.tooltip: General condition discovered vehicles will be in.

options.label: Car Damage on Impact
options.tooltip: The amount of damage dealt to vehicles that crash.

options.label: Player Damage From Vehicle Impact
options.tooltip: Damage received by the player from being crashed into.

options.label: Car Wreck Congestion
options.tooltip: If traffic jams consisting of wrecked cars will appear on main roads.

options.label: Vehicle Alarms Frequency
options.tooltip: How frequently discovered vehicles have active alarms.

options.label: Player Damage from Crash
options.tooltip: If the player can get injured from being in a car accident.

options.label: Chance Has Gas
options.tooltip: The chance of finding a vehicle with gas in its tank.

options.label: Recent Survivor Vehicles
options.tooltip: Whether a player can discover a car that has been cared for after the Knox infection struck.

options.label: Vehicle Sirens Attract Zombies
options.tooltip: If zombies will head towards the sound of vehicle sirens.

options.label: Firearms Use Damage Chance
options.tooltip: Replaces Chance-To-Hit mechanics with Chance-To-Damage calculations. This mode prioritizes player aiming.

options.label: Firearm Noise Multiplier
options.tooltip: A multiplier for the distance at which zombies can hear gunshots.

options.label: Firearm Jam Multiplier
options.tooltip: Multiplier for firearm jamming chance. 0 disables jamming.

options.label: Firearm Moodle Multiplier
options.tooltip: Multiplier for Moodle effects on hit chance. 0 disables Moodle penalty.

options.label: Firearm Weather Multiplier
options.tooltip: Multiplier for the effects of weather (wind, rain and fog) on hit chance. 0 disables weather effect.

options.label: Firearm Headgear Effect
options.tooltip: Enable to have headgear like welding masks affect hit chance

options.label: Stats Reduction Speed
options.tooltip: Speed at which animals stats (hunger, thirst etc.) reduce.

options.label: Meta Stats Reduction Speed
options.tooltip: Speed at which animals stats (hunger, thirst etc.) reduce while in meta.

options.label: Pregnancy Time
options.tooltip: How long animals will be pregnant for before giving birth.

options.label: Aging Modifier Speed
options.tooltip: Speed at which animals age.

options.label: Animal Spawn Chance
options.tooltip: The chance of finding animals in farm.

options.label: Grass Regrowth time
options.tooltip: The number of hours grass will regrow after being eaten by an animal or cut by the player.

options.label: Meta Predator
options.tooltip: If a meta (ie. not actually visible in-game) fox may attack your chickens if the hutch's door is left open at night.

options.label: Breeding Season
options.tooltip: If on, animals will only mate during their breeding season (if any). Otherwise they can reproduce/lay eggs all year round.

options.label: Egg Hatch Time
options.tooltip: How long before baby animals will hatch from eggs.

options.label: Animals Attract Zombies
options.tooltip: If true, animal calls will attract nearby zombies.

options.label: Animal Tracks Chance
options.tooltip: The chance of animals leaving tracks.

options.label: Animal Paths Chance
options.tooltip: The chance of creating a path for animals to be hunted.

options.label: Maximum Vermin Index
options.tooltip: The frequency and intensity of eg. rats in infested buildings.

options.label: Days Until Maximum Vermin Index
options.tooltip: How long it takes for the Maximum Vermin Index to be reached.

options.label: World Item Removal List
options.tooltip: A comma-separated list of item types that will be removed after HoursForWorldItemRemoval hours.

options.label: Hours for Removal List
options.tooltip: Number of hours since an item was dropped on the ground before it is removed. Items are removed the next time that part of the map is loaded. Zero means items are not removed.

options.label: Removal List as Whitelist
options.tooltip: If true, any items *not* in WorldItemRemovalList will be removed.

options.label: Light Bulb Lifespan
options.tooltip: The higher the value, the longer lightbulbs last before breaking. If 0, lightbulbs will never break. Does not affect vehicle headlights.

options.label: Blood Splat Lifespan Days
options.tooltip: Number of days before old blood splats are removed. Removal happens when map chunks are loaded. 0 means they will never disappear.

options.label: Maximum Fire Fuel Hours
options.tooltip: The maximum hours of fuel that can be placed in a campfire, wood stove etc.

options.label: Basement Spawn Frequency
options.tooltip: How frequently basements spawn at random locations.

options.label: Allow Mini-Map
options.tooltip: If enabled, a mini-map window will be available.

options.label: Allow World Map
options.tooltip: If enabled, the world map can be accessed.

options.label: All Known On Start
options.tooltip: If enabled, the world map will be completely filled in on starting the game.

options.label: Light Needed To Read Map
options.tooltip: If enabled, maps can't be read unless there's a source of light available.
